regions.today: There will be a mixture of sunny spells and further scattered showers this evening, some possibly heavy. All in light to moderate west to southwest winds, gusty at times, especially near showers.
regions.tonight: There will be a mixture of clear spells and scattered showers overnight. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees with light to moderate west to northwest winds, possibly gusty at times.
regions.tomorrow: On Thursday, there will be a mixture of sunny spells and scattered showers once again. Temperatures will reach 17 to 20 degrees and there’ll be light to moderate, sometimes gusty, northerly winds.
